en.name: Lobster tails, frozen
en.summary: Frozen lobster tails keep 8 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Keep them frozen and cook as directed. Once cooked, the meat keeps 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
en.pantry: No room-temperature storage, and never thaw a lobster tail on the counter. Shellfish is a high-protein, low-acid food and spoils quickly once it warms; it is also expensive enough that letting the texture go soft is a waste in its own right. Anything left out is in the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) and follows the two-hour rule, one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once cooked, covered, and that is what the figure describes — cooked meat, not raw thawed tails. A raw tail thawed in the fridge should be cooked the same day. Keep cooked lobster meat in a sealed box rather than loose on a plate, because it dries out fast and picks up fridge smells, and keep any shells you plan to use for stock separately.
en.freezer: 8 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. That is a quality window rather than a safety limit: tails held continuously at −18 °C stay safe indefinitely, and what runs out is texture and sweetness. Keep them in the original vacuum pack if they came in one; if not, wrap tightly and overwrap, because exposed lobster meat frost-burns quickly and goes cottony. Do not buy a pack heavy with ice inside or with tails frozen together in a lump.
en.thawing: Thaw overnight in the fridge, or in a sealed bag under cold running water if you are short of time. Never on the counter, never in warm water, and never in the microwave — lobster goes rubbery at the edges before the middle has thawed. A tail thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) may be refrozen with some quality loss; one thawed warm must not be.
spoilage: An ammonia smell, which is decisive for shellfish — discard it.
Dry, white, frost-burned patches on exposed meat.
Meat that looks chalky or cottony rather than translucent.
Heavy ice inside the pack, or tails welded together, meaning it part-thawed and refroze.
tips: Buy vacuum-packed tails where you can; exposed meat frost-burns fast.
Thaw in the fridge overnight — the texture is noticeably better than a fast thaw.
Cook them just until the meat turns opaque; overcooking is what makes lobster rubbery.
Keep the shells for stock and freeze them separately.

faq.q: How long do frozen lobster tails last?
faq.a: 8 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Kept continuously frozen they stay safe beyond that, but the texture and sweetness go.

faq.q: How do you thaw lobster tails?
faq.a: Overnight in the fridge, or in a sealed bag under cold running water. Never on the counter, in warm water or in the microwave.

faq.q: How long does cooked lobster keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in a sealed box.

zh.name: 冷凍龍蝦尾
zh.summary: 冷凍龍蝦尾在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可保有最佳品質 8 個月。請保持冷凍並依指示烹調。煮熟之後，蝦肉放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
zh.pantry: 沒有室溫保存，也絕對不要在檯面上退冰。甲殼類是高蛋白、低酸的食物，一回溫就壞得很快；而且它本身夠貴，光是讓口感變糊就已經是浪費。任何擺在外面的都在 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶裡，適用兩小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。
zh.fridge: 煮熟之後蓋好放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天，而這個數字描述的正是「熟蝦肉」，不是解凍的生蝦尾。在冷藏解凍的生蝦尾應該當天煮掉。熟蝦肉請裝進密封盒，不要裸放在盤子上，因為它乾得很快又很會吸冰箱的味道；要留來熬湯的殼請另外分開放。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下自購買日起 8 個月品質最好。那是品質期限而不是安全上限：全程維持在 −18 °C 的蝦尾可以無限期保持安全，先用完的是口感和甜味。原本有真空包裝的就留在真空包裝裡；沒有的話請包緊再加一層，因為裸露的龍蝦肉凍燒得很快，會變得像棉絮。包裝內結了厚冰、或幾隻凍在一起成一團的不要買。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏隔夜解凍，時間不夠就密封裝袋泡在流動冷水下。絕對不要放檯面、不要泡溫水、也不要微波——微波會讓邊緣先變橡皮，中心卻還沒解開。在冷藏解凍、且維持在 4 °C 以下的可以再冷凍，只是品質打折；回溫過的絕對不行。
spoilage: 聞到氨味——對甲殼類來說這是決定性的，直接丟掉。
裸露的蝦肉出現乾白的凍燒斑塊。
蝦肉看起來粉粉的、像棉絮，而不是半透明的。
包裝內結厚冰，或幾隻黏成一團，表示曾經半退冰又再凍。
tips: 盡量買真空包裝的；裸露的蝦肉凍燒得很快。
冷藏隔夜解凍——口感明顯比快速解凍好。
煮到蝦肉剛好變不透明就好；龍蝦會變橡皮都是因為煮過頭。
殼留下來熬湯，另外分開冷凍。

faq.q: 冷凍龍蝦尾可以放多久？
faq.a: −18 °C 下自購買日起 8 個月品質最好。只要沒退冰放更久仍然安全，但口感和甜味會掉。
放冷藏隔夜，或密封裝袋泡流動冷水。絕對不要放檯面、泡溫水或微波。

faq.q: 煮好的龍蝦肉冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 裝密封盒放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天。
